`goravel-authz` v1.17.0 targets Goravel 1.17.x. Install it with
`go get github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz@v1.17.0`.

### Added

- The same Casbin adapter capabilities as v1.18.0: batch add and remove, single and batch update, update by filter, filtered loading and transactional rollback.
- The same HTTP middleware capabilities as v1.18.0: `WithGuards`, `WithTokens`, `Ability`, and the Goravel Auth and Gate integration.

### Changed

- Adapted to the Goravel 1.17 middleware type: `Authz` and `Ability` return `func(http.Context)`.
- `authz:policy:list` renders its own aligned table, because the Goravel 1.17 `console.Context` has no `Table` method.
- Adapted to the Goravel 1.17 logging, ORM constructor and connection pool reset APIs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wcz0/goravel-authz/compare/v0.5.0...v1.17.0
